kind.description: RC passages and VA questions fail for different reasons and are analysed separately

domain.description: RC only — subject domain. Blind spots hide here.

va_type.description: VA only. Para Jumble and Odd Sentence Out are TITA — no negative marking, so always attempt.

passage_difficulty.description: RC only — how hard the passage was to read

question_difficulty.description: RC only — how hard the questions were. Vault insight: difficult passage tends to carry easy questions and vice versa.

read_time_seconds.description: RC only — time to read the passage once. Target ~2-2.5 min for ~500 words.

summary_written.description: RC only — did you write the 3-line summary from memory before answering? Vault discipline.

error_type.description: Primary reason marks were lost — each needs a different fix

notes.description: What the author's actual argument was; what you missed
